recipe_version.title: Spanish Potato Tortilla
recipe_version.description: Yukon Gold potatoes and onion shallow-fried in olive oil, folded into egg, and set in a skillet. No cheese and no chorizo.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: enough for a shallow layer in a 10-inch skillet; most is drained off and can be saved; 2 tbsp goes back into the skillet

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 8 g on the potatoes and onion while they cook, 3 g in the eggs. 11 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (4 tsp). The same weight is 2.25 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 1.75 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Slice
steps.body: Slice the potatoes into thin rounds and the onion thin. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Shallow-fry the potatoes
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Add the potatoes and onion, keep them in a shallow layer of oil, and cook, turning gently, until the potatoes are tender but not browned hard, about 18 minutes. Salt them with 8 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt as they cook. Taste one potato, which is cooked, before it goes into the eggs, and add a pinch more salt only if it tastes flat. Drain, and reserve the oil.

steps.title: Set and flip
steps.body: Beat the eggs with the remaining 3 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt and the pepper. Fold in the potatoes and onion. Return 2 tbsp of the oil to the skillet over medium-low. Pour in the eggs and cook until the edge is set and the top is still moist, about 8 minutes. Invert onto a plate, slide it back, and cook about 4 minutes more, until the center is just firm. Scatter the parsley and cut into wedges.
